name: Easy Dutch Oven Mediterranean Chicken, Potatoes,  Carrots & Peppers with Feta

ingredients.name: frozen pepper and onion strips (fajita vegetable blend)

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g new potatoes
1 lemon
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Halve new potatoes. Peel, trim, and cut carrots crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Place both in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a Dutch oven over medium heat.
While the Dutch oven heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.

Once the Dutch oven is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 3-4 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the veggies.

When the chicken is golden, add potatoes, carrots, lemon, frozen peppers and onions, garlic, and spices to the Dutch oven. Stir to combine, cover with a lid, and place in the oven. Bake until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender, about 1 hour 30 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (397 g) pkg frozen pepper and onion strips (fajita vegetable blend)
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the chicken and veggies are done, using a clean cutting board, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide chicken, veggies, and sauce between plates or bowls, then sprinkle with parsley and feta. Enjoy!
